title: Public Service Loan Forgiveness - basics
facts: Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) can forgive the remaining balance on eligible Direct Loans after a borrower satisfies program requirements, including qualifying employment and 120 qualifying monthly payments.
PSLF eligibility is based on the employer, not the borrower's job title; qualifying employment generally includes eligible government and not-for-profit employment under program rules.
Payments do not need to be consecutive, but the borrower must satisfy the program's qualifying-payment and employment rules.
Private student loans are not eligible for PSLF.
